response.justification: While Bogdan is a highly accomplished software engineer with 17+ years of experience and proven leadership abilities, he is fundamentally misaligned with this role's core requirements. His C++ development experience ended over a decade ago (last significant role: National Instruments 2014–2015), and his career has since focused entirely on web/full-stack development (TypeScript, Node.js, React, DLang). Critically, he demonstrates no security expertise (SDL, IEC 62443) or industrial automation domain knowledge—both central to this position. Though he possesses strong general software engineering fundamentals, the combination of a 10-year C++ gap, absent industrial domain expertise, and zero security/compliance background makes him unsuitable without substantial foundational retraining.
strengths: Exceeds seniority requirement with 17+ years of professional experience and demonstrated technical leadership across multiple staff-level roles
Excellent mentoring and communication skills evidenced by multiple public workshops, teaching roles, and knowledge-sharing initiatives
Deep understanding of distributed systems and event-driven architectures demonstrated through work on high-scale infrastructure (Dunnhumby, GISCollective)
concerns: No C++ development work for over 10 years; career trajectory shows consistent pivot away from systems programming toward web/modern stacks
Complete absence of security and compliance expertise (SDL, IEC 62443, industrial cybersecurity standards)—these are core responsibilities, not secondary skills
No industrial automation, manufacturing, or IoT domain experience; recent work focused on direct-mail optimization, web platforms, and AI infrastructure
